analysis.nicheMapping: Laundry cleaning product concept maps to pest control: 'proven cleaning power that removes stains' becomes 'proven technology that removes pests'; 'dissolves completely, no residue' becomes 'works completely, no toxic residue'; 'safe for clothes and skin' becomes 'safe for family and pets'; demonstration of sheets dissolving becomes demonstration of pest elimination process
analysis.suggestedPrompt:
REPLICATE THE REFERENCE IMAGE EXACTLY. Only two types of changes are permitted: (1) replace 'Green FLOW' with 'Bugo' and (2) replace the laundry product box and glass demonstration with the Bugo ultrasonic pest repeller device. Every visual element — colors, layout, typography, icons, button shape, gradients — must be pixel-identical to the reference.

BACKGROUND: Soft light gray-blue gradient background (#E8EAED to #F5F7FA), subtle and clean with no texture or pattern.

BRAND LOGO (top-left corner): 'Bugo' in elegant serif font, dark blue color (#2E5A87), same size and position as 'Green FLOW', with small leaf accent replaced by small wave/signal icon.

MAIN HEADLINE (top-right, large text): 
Line 1: 'בית נקי באמת,' — bold dark blue (#2E5A87), large sans-serif font
Line 2: 'בטוח למשפחה.' — bold dark blue (#2E5A87), same font size

PRODUCT IMAGE (bottom-left): REMOVE the laundry box and glass completely. Replace with the Bugo device: white oval/egg-shaped ultrasonic pest repeller positioned at slight angle, blue LED glow effect (#4A90C2) from bottom rim, 'Bugo' text visible on device face in gray. Position device where the box was, with soft shadow beneath.

BENEFIT ICONS (right side, vertical column, 4 circular icons):
Icon 1 (top): White t-shirt with sparkles → Shield with checkmark icon, blue circle background (#4A90C2)
Icon 2: Hands → House silhouette with protective dome, blue circle background (#4A90C2) 
Icon 3: Water drops → Sound waves radiating, blue circle background (#4A90C2)
Icon 4 (bottom): Washing machine → Coverage area icon (concentric circles), blue circle background (#4A90C2)

BENEFIT TEXT (right of each icon, right-aligned RTL):
Benefit 1: 'עוצמת הדברה מוכחת' — dark blue (#2E5A87), medium sans-serif
'להרחקת מזיקים' — smaller text, same color
Benefit 2: 'בטוח למשפחה' — dark blue (#2E5A87), medium sans-serif  
'וחיות מחמד' — smaller text, same color
Benefit 3: 'פועל ללא הפסקה,' — dark blue (#2E5A87), medium sans-serif
'ללא כימיקלים' — smaller text, same color
Benefit 4: 'מתאים לכל הבית' — dark blue (#2E5A87), medium sans-serif
'ומשרדים' — smaller text, same color

CTA BUTTON (bottom center, spanning nearly full width): Rounded rectangle with dark blue background (#2E5A87), white text in medium bold font: 'הזמינו את בוגו לבית נקי ממזיקים'

ASPECT RATIO: 1:1

DO NOT add any element not present in the reference. DO NOT remove any visual element except the specific product replacement. DO NOT reposition any element. Maintain exact spacing, typography hierarchy, and color relationships from the reference image.
